# kinsta_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up a zone on Kinsta DNS by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kinsta_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Zone ID, for `kinsta_dns_record.zone_id`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the zone is active.
- `site_id` (String) Site the zone is linked to, if any.
